details.eligibility: Bachelor's degree; age 18–32 years (TN rules; relaxations apply). Tamil language eligibility test in Mains.
details.pattern: Prelims: 200 questions (GS + Aptitude & Mental Ability, 300 marks, 3 hours). Mains: Paper I Tamil Eligibility Test + Paper II General Studies (descriptive). Interview for Group 2 (not 2A).
details.syllabus: Tamil Nadu GK, Polity, History, Geography, Economy, Science, Aptitude.
details.important_dates: TNPSC Group 2/2A Prelims 2026 held 1 Nov 2026 (per Prepp/Adda247 pages).
